title: ViGeB* - Promoting diversity: Gender diversity in professional life - Exploratory, sequential mixed-methods design for researching barriers and supporting factors for trans*, inter*, and non-binary gendered individuals with (mental) disabilities in professional life
summary:
This study examines how various stressors and support factors affect the work situation of trans*, inter* and non-binary (hereinafter: TIN*) individuals with (mental) disabilities. The study follows a two-stage approach (mixed methods design):
First, guided interviews are conducted with TIN* individuals and focus groups with colleagues of TIN* individuals. The aim is to gain a deeper understanding of the barriers, needs and resources of TIN* individuals with (mental) disabilities in the work context. Based on these results, a cross-sectional survey with standardised questionnaires will then be conducted. This should help to analyse the diversity of individual experiences and the relationships between various influencing factors in more detail. In the long term, the results will contribute to the development of targeted measures and materials in the ViGeB* project to improve the inclusion, visibility and support of TIN* individuals with (mental) disabilities in the world of work.
conditions: Research into barriers and enabling factors for trans*, inter* and non-binary gendered persons with (mental) disabilities in working life

Inclusion criteria:
trans*, inter*, non-binary, cis with/without (mental) disabilities and sufficient understanding of the German language
Exclusion criteria:
Persons under the age of 18, persons who are not authorised to give their consent, and persons who do not have a sufficient understanding of the German language.
